rows.ARS:
Medium pink Floribunda.
Registration name: FRYdabble
Exhibition name: Jack Wood
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Fryer's Roses says Jack Wood is the best in its color range for mass bedding. It is bushy with dense healthy, bright green foliage and vibrant pink blooms. This rose is named for Jack Woods, the well known veteran Garden News correspondent.
